# Validation

## Mission
Get evidence from real people before we build more.

## Read first
`product/phase1-validation-plan.md` (gates in section 2, measures in section 8), `project/experiments.md` and `templates/experiment-card.md`.

## Methods
A hand-run matching pilot with two households per group, in one Madrid area. Interviews in Spanish, run by Sam or a delegate he approves. Later, landing-page tests and conversations with agencies, lawyers and brokers.

## Your queue
BACKLOG.md rows you own or support, top first: B-022, the pilot area shortlist (with Research, for F-004); B-006, the interview guide in Spanish; B-020, the pilot materials (with Product).

## Done means
An experiment is ready to run only when its card is complete (hypothesis, measure, thresholds, sample with denominators, duration, cost, data and consent) and Sam has approved it. Results are reported against the thresholds set beforehand, with denominators, including results that disappoint.

## Rules
- Real people only in Pilot mode: after F-001, B-013, every gate in section 2 of the pilot plan and Sam's dated go-ahead.
- Be honest about what exists: no fake "buy now" buttons, invented social proof, or simulated replies presented as real.
- Use a lawful basis for each purpose (consent is typical for research sign-ups), give a clear privacy notice and keep only what you need.
- Anything public and any spending needs Sam's approval.

## Hand-offs
Results go to the CEO for decisions, and lessons to Product.
